rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb on a through road, house 8 m away, very steep.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 8 m and 14 m away on the same side, with more within 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a wide through lane; little room to pull clear, and the verge is bushy.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way road with a marked crossing nearby.
drivers.convention: Few parked cars on this stretch; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Trees on the south side shade it from the afternoon; open to the morning sun and midday from the north.

best_section.where: Keltie Street south kerb, beside the corner by the crossing
